step1_analysis.circuit_type: Pseudo-differential cascode amplifier and common-source amplifiers
step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of a pseudo-differential cascode amplifier (XM1, XM3, XM5, XM6) and two independent common-source amplifiers (XM2, XM4). Given the RF transceiver context, this is likely used as a low-noise amplifier (LNA), RF buffer, or a transconductance stage in the front-end.

Voltage Gain (Cascode).description: Maximum AC voltage gain of the pseudo-differential cascode amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. With W/L=5/0.5, Vov~0.48V, Id~310uA, gm~1.3mS. With a 5kOhm load, Gain = gm*Rload = 6.5 V/V = 16.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load resistor in the testbench. 5kOhm gives a reasonable gain comparable to the paper.

Voltage Gain (CS).description: Maximum AC voltage gain of the common-source amplifier pair

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to the cascode stage, gm~1.3mS. With a 5kOhm load, Gain = gm*Rload = 6.5 V/V = 16.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The common-source pair has similar dimensions and bias, yielding similar gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2*pi*Rload*Cout). With Rload=5kOhm and Cout~10fF, the -3dB BW is ~3.1 GHz. The 0dB bandwidth will be higher.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant at the output node. 2.4 GHz operation is well within the capabilities of SKY130.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the bias conditions (0.9V gate) and transistor sizes in SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure AC voltage gain, bandwidth, and DC power consumption of the pseudo-differential cascode and common-source amplifiers.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pseudo-differential cascode amplifier testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

* Power supply
VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Load resistors (5k ohms for reasonable gain)
R1 VDD N11 5k
R2 VDD N10 5k
R3 VDD N6 5k
R4 VDD N7 5k

* Bias and Input Sources
Vbias_casc N2 0 1.2
Vbias_in1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9 ac 1
Vbias_in3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9 ac -1
Vbias_in4 N4 0 0.9 ac 1
Vbias_in9 N9 0 0.9 ac -1

* DUT
XM1 N11 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N10 N2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N7 N9 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

.control
  * DC Operating Point and Power
  op
  let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
  
  * Cascode Amplifier Gain
  let vout_diff = v(N10) - v(N11)
  let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff) / 2
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  
  * Common-Source Amplifier Gain
  let vout_cs_diff = v(N6) - v(N7)
  let gain_cs_mag = mag(vout_cs_diff) / 2
  let gain_cs_db = 20 * log10(gain_cs_mag)
  
  * Measurements
  meas ac gain_max max gain_db
  meas ac gain_cs_max max gain_cs_db
  meas ac gain_2G4 find gain_db at=2.4Gig
  meas ac bw_0db when gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  print gain_max gain_cs_max gain_2G4 bw_0db
  quit
.endc
.end
